areas.name: Configuration integrity
areas.about: Ids resolve, nothing is orphaned, deprecated patterns are gone.

areas.name: Data sources and queries
areas.about: The right query, bounded, triggered at the right time, refreshed after writes.

areas.name: Performance and page weight
areas.about: What the page costs to load and render.

areas.name: Custom code and expressions
areas.about: Page functions, scripts, bindings and custom CSS that are correct and earn their place.

areas.name: Loading, empty and error states
areas.about: Every data-bound surface says what is happening.

areas.name: Components
areas.about: Tables, repeatables, forms, charts, cards and Copilot used the way they are built to be used.

areas.name: Layout, sizing and responsive
areas.about: Sizes, scroll and per-device overrides that hold on every screen.

areas.name: Navigation and routing
areas.about: Menus, page paths and back controls.

areas.name: Theme, styles and branding
areas.about: Tokens over hard-coded values; the client's brand.

areas.name: Security and access
areas.about: Who can open what, and what can leak.

areas.name: Accessibility
areas.about: Names, labels, contrast and titles.

areas.name: Naming, copy and localisation
areas.about: Names a builder can read, words a user can read.

areas.name: Intent and simplicity
areas.about: Judgment calls: does the page do its job, with as little as it needs.

areas.name: How it is built
areas.about: Signs a page was built the wrong way even when every setting is valid: workarounds, guessed context, hidden behaviour, copies and dead weight. They make it break quietly and hard to change.

areas.name: Files and uploads
areas.about: Who can open what users upload, and where it is stored.

areas.name: Export and print
areas.about: PDF export and print layouts that come out whole and on time.

areas.name: Objects the app binds to

rules.rule: Icon Button Must Have Tooltip or Accessible Label
Set a document title on every page
Show a status with an icon or word besides colour; keep status colours out of chart series
Give images meaningful alt text, or empty alt if decorative
Action-only clickable text is a Button, not a Link without a url; a Link with no href cannot be reached by keyboard
Wrap custom CSS motion in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)
Put a word beside an icon unless the icon is universal, such as search or close
Give every IconButton a tooltip add-on; the icon is its only name otherwise
Name controls with additional.htmlAttributes aria-label rows; content.ariaLabel is not a block key
Replace an Image's seeded alt text "placeholder" with a real description, or empty alt for decoration
Give an AxisRichTextEditor standing in for a labelled input a content.ariaLabel; it renders no label of its own
Give MessageInput and CopilotInput actions a label; it is the button's accessible name and tooltip
Give an IconButton's slot-mode tooltip real words in content; an empty string announces nothing
Turn on at least one guardrail: blocked messaging, denied topics, word filter, PII redaction or content filter
Give every model the agent and its indexing name an active connection; no default or half-set model fields
Attach only knowledge sources that finished processing and indexing
Give the agent a clear, unambiguous name, goals, role and instructions
Give every app an agent tool uses an active runtime connection
Turn on context compaction for the agent
Set the agent's response model, language, tone, style and format
Mask PII when indexing knowledge and in agent queries
Move a task's only tool up to an agent-level tool
Give every agent task and tool a clear name and a description of when to use it
Set user-friendly blocked messages for both prompt and response guardrails
Set guardrail values and thresholds that fit the agent's job
Expose complex operations to an agent through an automation, not as raw tools
Give an agent an automation tool instead of indexing an object past a few thousand records as knowledge
Run the Agent Optimizer on staging and clear its findings before an agent review
Budget agent tokens; trim the system prompt, knowledge and query tools when each takes about a third
Trim tool descriptions to what the agent needs; one was 34k tokens
Remove default tools the agent cannot use, such as Generate Public Url or web search
Strip system and audit fields like sys_id and sys_created_by from indexed knowledge metadata
Cut repeated instructions, chit-chat examples and excess few-shots from agent prompts
Turn on prompt caching and parallel tool calls, and set reasoning effort on purpose
Check traces for an agent that ignores tool results or re-fetches knowledge in one turn
Prove every agent prompt or tool change with a before and after eval run
Attach every skill and tool the agent's instructions name, under the exact name the model sees
Never name a switched-off tool in the agent's instructions
Never ask an agent to do something it has no tool for, like fetching a website without web search
Resolve pairs of absolute rules (NEVER, ALWAYS, MUST) in agent instructions and skills that order different actions
Remove tool descriptions that tell the agent to invent data rather than ask or say not found
Remove tools the agent has no use for; an IngestKnowledge tool lets any user add files to the shared knowledge
Never rely on a tool description to hide data; restrict it in the tool or the connection's permissions
Describe every tool parameter and mark the required ones required
Keep the agent's tool list the same across turns of one conversation so prompt caching holds
Keep personal names, emails, internal URLs and ticket ids out of agent prompts, and add a rule against revealing them
Remove or disable automation nodes whose output nothing downstream reads
Turn off input and output capture on nodes that carry secret keys so reporting never ingests them
Leave capture loop iteration off on nodes unless needed; it writes a report row per iteration
Keep node retries to 5 or fewer, initial delay up to 1 s, max delay up to 30 s, backoff factor 1 to 5
Read the create-record node's output; never fetch the same record by id right after creating it
Run a Custom HTTP call asynchronously when its timeout is 60 s or more
Remove a For loop whose counter is a fixed 1
Set an explicit timeout on every Custom HTTP call; unset or -1 waits forever
Give every analytics SQL query a WHERE or a LIMIT clause
Give every While loop a real exit or Max Iterations; a condition comparing a value with itself never ends
Nest loops at most two deep; move a third level into a sub-automation
Use a Break or Continue node's own condition instead of wiring it from an If/Else
Use Count records, not Fetch records, when only the count is read
Turn on retries for external Custom HTTP requests
Turn on caching for a Custom HTTP call inside a loop
Prefer file-based SQL or analytics actions over list-based ones for large datasets
Add a JSON deserialize node after calling an LLM automation, before reading its fields
Never call LLM automations through Call Automation (Batch); call each one on its own
Use datapills without spaces in CSV or Excel header values
Call a callable without waiting for completion when nothing reads its output
Give an API-triggered automation a non-200 response and return it from a Respond to API request node
Replace if/else nested more than two levels deep with one Branch node
Turn on distribute load for Call Automation (Batch) when it waits for completion or runs IN_MEMORY
Keep analytics SQL to one JOIN at most; split the query or pre-aggregate
Set Custom HTTP nodes to Follow Error Path (MANUAL) with at least one node on the error path
Replace a single-record create, upsert or update inside a loop with one bulk node outside it
Don't build a list with Add item to list inside a loop; use the loop's collected output or Add items to list
Use one upsert instead of create in one branch and update in the other on the same object
Take a Custom HTTP base URL from an environment or workflow variable, not a literal
Keep a Custom HTTP base URL to scheme and host; put the path in the request path
Split an automation that reaches 75 nodes
Split an automation that reaches 125 nodes; it is hard to maintain and troubleshoot
Split an automation that reaches 175 nodes; it slows execution and strains the environment
Prefer a Groovy code node over JavaScript, Python or other runtimes for compute-heavy steps
Define every environment variable an automation reads on the Environment Variables page
Turn off a loop's Capture Iterations once debugging is done
Map one output field like {{node.outputs.id}}, never the whole {{node.outputs}} object
Never hard-code passwords, secrets, tokens, client or account ids, endpoints or auth values in node inputs
Set Content-Type in the request's Content-Type field, never again in Custom HTTP headers
Use the REST or SOAP Multipart action for a multipart Content-Type
Check binding.hasVariable before reading an optional input in a Groovy node
Define the output schema of every code node so downstream nodes get datapills
Don't nest a scope inside another scope
Remove skip nodes left over from development
Turn on DLQ tracking (enableDlqTracking) when polling event streams, or failed events are lost
Set triggerAfterCompletion false on stream triggers so events process in parallel
Keep a For Each loop's batch size at 1000 or less
Remove or initialise a variable that is created empty and never assigned
Use Create List, not an Array variable in Create Variables
Keep delays in an in-memory automation at 2 minutes or less
Never delay an in-memory automation by more than 5 minutes
Never run an analytics query inside a For Each loop
Give every condition node at least one condition
Never schedule an automation more often than once a minute
Remove a Change Text Encoding step whose current and new encoding match
Remove a MIME type conversion whose source and target types match
Declare main-flow variables in one Create Variables node; use more only inside branches
Turn on Capture Stdout on a Python code node that prints or logs
Turn on Capture Stdout on a C# code node that writes to the console or logs
Map only a List or Array into a For Each loop
Give every Wait for Signal action a non-zero timeout
End a code node by returning a map or object literal (or result = {...}), as the compiler expects
Use Call Automation, not the Batch variant, for a hard-coded parameter list of one
Never create records in the same object from parallel branches
Check presence with the Is present operator, not LEN()>0 or LEN()>=1
Check emptiness with the Is not present operator, not LEN()=0
Never create in one parallel branch while another updates the same object
Build the full list and write Excel once outside the loop, never row by row inside it
Send an auth header or auth query parameter on every Custom HTTP Endpoint call
Use Iterate over rows, not Extract data from sheet, for Excel files that can be large
Turn on streaming for Excel Iterate over rows
List the fields a Fetch records node needs; never fetch every column
Prefer structured filters or parameterised queries over raw SQL execute actions
Turn off use_excelize on Extract headers unless excelize is needed
Map at least one input pill into every storage create or update node
Break any Call Automation cycle where a downstream automation calls this one back
Never write to the object or stream that triggered the automation, directly or through a callee
Keep PII, payment data, credentials and health data out of node inputs, outputs and logs
Clear code-security findings in code nodes: injection, hard-coded secrets, exfiltration, unsafe deserialisation
Query objects only on indexed fields; an unindexed filter forces a full scan
Never call Thread.sleep or similar in Groovy code; use a Delay node, a signal or a retry policy
Assume an automation an app or agent calls runs IN_MEMORY: 5-minute timeout and 256 MiB budget, whatever mode it shows
Keep waits in an automation an app calls under 2 minutes; put long waits in the node's retry config
Keep an endpoint-fronted automation shorter than the endpoint timeout (often 30 s), or its runs are cancelled
Never have an automation call itself to fetch the next page; page inside one run with a loop
Pass a whole list to a child automation instead of calling it once per record; call it async if nothing reads the output
Wait on many child automations with signals, not a blocking batch loop that stalls on the slowest child
Call an outside system with a list when it accepts one; write down when it does not
Send one summary email with a table, never one email per record
Count database and external calls per run, not loop turns; a loop that batches but still calls once per item is not fixed
Give every record read in an automation a date filter, with a default range when the caller passes none
Fetch matching records once and use Run SQL query on list instead of one lookup per item
Process and write each batch as you go; never collect every row into one list first
Use the update step's add-to-set option instead of fetch, change a list, write back
Use fetch distinct values instead of fetching every record to find one field's unique values
Set one value on many records with one update-by-filter call, not one update per record
Replace two loops over one table with one query that serves both
Give every batch size a stated reason; large batches exceed the 256 MiB per-execution budget
Move a fetch that does not depend on the iteration out of the loop
Store a derived value as a column instead of computing it with regex inside analytics queries
Combine separate queries that one query can answer, especially across branches
Use built-in actions, such as Excel iterate over rows, instead of parsing files by hand in code
Merge code steps that sit next to each other into one, and drop code steps a native step covers
Run independent checks in parallel branches instead of one after another
Collapse identical steps on both sides of a condition into one path
Loop over a list rather than until a condition; if a condition loop stays, cap its turns
Move heavy row-by-row validation out of the parent into an async child automation
Set a failure alert on the Alerts tab for every scheduled or client-facing automation
Give LLM steps an error path, and handle predictable bad input (a locked PDF) without crashing the run
Map model parameters like maxOutputTokens from the model's own config; never above the model's cap
Pass ids or references between steps, not big payloads; one 20 MB payload grew to gigabytes
Check calls per shared connection against its pool size; parallel batches can exhaust it for every flow
Dedupe visited items in any recursive or call-graph walk
Use pages of 5,000 to 50,000 records in large jobs; never above 50,000
Download a file once before the loop, never inside it
Replace an AI step doing predictable work in a loop with a code step or one batched prompt
Use keyset paging for big jobs whose later pages slow down under OFFSET paging
Split one huge source file into chunks rather than processing it in one run
Don't flag a loop for its number of turns when its writes are already bulk
Keep the build as simple as the page's job: its flow fits in 3 plain sentences, it holds no part the job does not need, and someone who does not write code can change it in the builder
Use what the platform offers, not scripts, click or key listeners, timers, watchers, fake key presses or CSS that patch or hide what it does; a workaround breaks quietly when the platform changes
Keep a value that matters in one saved record every screen reads; not only in page memory, browser storage or two copies that drift
Pass ids, the host and the user into the page; never work them out from the web address, the app around it or fixed demo names
Build for where people really open the page (a chat card, another app, a phone), not only for the builder preview or a design frame
Everything a page does shows in the builder: no modals opened hidden on load and closed by script, attributes used as switches, or inputs that silently replace defaults
Build a thing once and share it; a header, screen, menu or query copied to 2 places drifts apart
Show done, failed or slow from the real state the server reports, never from a timer or a fixed schedule, and stop checking when the work ends
Remove what nothing opens, reads or shows: unreachable pages, conditions that never change, always-hidden blocks, menu rows that do nothing, test leftovers
Custom CSS should be valid
Fix custom CSS marked invalid before publishing
Use `Reset Fields` instead of `Reset Field`
Use `Set Fields Value` instead of `Set Field Value`
Reuse the page function instead of a Run Script with the same code
Use Reset Fields Instead of Reset in Forms
Use setFieldValues instead of setFieldValue in forms
Avoid executeScript where a native action exists
Fix custom CSS the save marked invalid (`additional.isCustomCSSValid: false`)
Make a page function read its source in the body as `{{ e_<dsId>[…] }}`, so `dataSourceIds` is non-empty
Store flags as condition objects, never a raw `{{ a && b }}` string
Test array emptiness with `.length == 0`, not an is-empty check
Remove IIFEs and parser-breaking filter operators from bindings; move aggregation into a page function
No early return followed by more logic
No window.open or document access in functions; use platform actions
Page-load code never reads block state before blocks mount
Variable types match their use (no .map on a string)
Visibility operators and values match the bound property's type
Remove banned custom CSS: viewport units, `position:fixed`, `cursor` without an event
Check custom CSS keys are real CSS properties
Move app-chrome rules from a block's custom CSS into the app's custom code header
Scope app-wide header/footer CSS under `.nocode-navigation-container`, `.interface-theme` or `html:not(:has(.ua-builder-side-nav))`
Name the block, `[data-block-id='<id>']`, in every top-level rule of a block's custom CSS
Move a `{{ }}` out of custom CSS into an HTML attribute and select on that attribute
Move `@font-face` and `@import` out of block custom CSS into the page or app header
Narrow page or app header `<style>` rules to a block id, a set attribute or an app-wide scope
Lift every `<script>` in page or app code to the top level
Make a page function read every source in its body; split multi-source automatic functions
No WIP names (Temp_, _v2, _copy) or TODO and FIXME left in bodies
Never leave `{{ }}` layout arithmetic inside display text
A function's name matches what its body does
One return shape per function
Guard nested reads of variables that may not be set yet
Time-axis aggregations fill empty buckets with zero
Empty array, null and missing key are handled the same way
Compare and format dates with an explicit timezone
Every evalJS, executeScript and page function earns its place over native actions
Currency, units and locale formatting are consistent
Never put a // comment inside a {{ }} binding; it silently empties the value
An automatic page function must not read a manual data source; it loses the dependency and goes blank after each refetch
No literal date or timestamp stands for today or now; compute it at run time in the user's time zone, not UTC
Mint record numbers on the server and show the returned code; never build them in the page with random, Date.now or count + 1
For a paginated source test emptiness on totalRecords or the first row's id; the pager wraps an undefined list as [null] so length is 1
Wait for a script loaded in the app custom code header (such as the Teams SDK) before On page load code reads it from window
Never pick a page, branch or value by matching visible text such as a title or label; use an id or key from the data
Keep one copy of each mapping (status to stage, category list, catalogue); copies drift and give different answers
Write an effect many blocks share as one header rule on a shared HTML attribute, not the same CSS pasted into each block
Put a device-specific CSS change in @media; a device on a block customCSS edit is ignored
In custom CSS animate only transform and opacity, easing out, never bounce
Keep transitions at 100 to 150 ms for a press, 200 to 300 ms for hover, 300 to 500 ms to open, at most 800 ms for an entrance
Don't read var(--ds-*) from page header or footer markup; it sits outside .interface-theme and gets no value
Page and app scripts may reach only user, customer, environment and modules; they cannot read blocks, variables or sources
Guard globals in page and app scripts and undo timers and listeners on __CLEANUP__; a script can run twice and throws silently
Never write a bare app-header rule on [data-nav-root], .ua-side-nav-item, .MuiDrawer-content or .bg-workspace; it restyles the builder
Write controlBlockMethod's methodName as a literal; a binding there matches nothing and the step does nothing
Guard a controlBlockMethod whose blockId comes from storage with a runCondition that the key exists
Write session storage through its action, never the setValue method, which resolves and stores nothing
No !important in theme or block CSS unless the base rule it overrides uses it
Keep regex, length checks and validation messages out of blocks and actions; read one validator function's result
Give a button one plain action chain; render one button per mode instead of runConditions on each step
No condition that is always true or always false
No page variable that only copies a data source's data and never changes; bind the source
No customCSS key that repeats appearance.styles or sets a value back to its default
No async work (await, fetch, a promise) inside a binding; bindings are synchronous
Read a page function as func_<id>['value']; never call it with ()
Never rely on a set-value action to fire the target's onChange; programmatic changes fire no user event
Treat platform dates as epoch milliseconds, never seconds; a date-only string means midnight UTC
Never read document, window, localStorage or fetch in a {{ }} binding; read-only evaluation answers undefined for all of them
Store literal text as plain text, not as {{ "hello" }}; a wrapped literal stays a live expression that is evaluated
Wrap a condition stored in appearance.disabled, readOnly or loading as {type:'filter',payload}; a bare group is truthy forever
Write a constant disabled flag as {type:'boolean',payload:true}, not a bare true the condition panel cannot read
Write a disabled condition for when the control should NOT work; an inverted one kills it exactly when it is needed
Treat a date field's epoch value as milliseconds when passing it on to an API
Bind appearance.loading through a filter condition, not a raw {{ }}, so the panel shows it
Never carry a {conditionalValueFilters, defaultValue} wrapper into appearance.disabled; it is not collapsed there and stays truthy
Gate a stepper's Next action with a runCondition; allowNavigation only blocks clicking the track
Match stepper visibility conditions on a step's value, never its label or an invented id
Read a Table's page size as b_<id>['content']['page'], with no addOns segment
Write an IN or NOT_IN list as a {{ [...] }} binding; a raw JSON array is wiped the first time a maker opens the condition
Use only operators in the condition menu; an unknown one like ICONTAINS throws and the whole condition tree reads false
Put page-state logic in {type:'filter'}; a {type:'boolean'} payload holding an expression string always reads true
Never store an empty condition group; empty AND is always true and a group without filters is always false
Write condition operands as strings ("0", "true"), never raw numbers or booleans
Don't use MIN_LENGTH or MAX_LENGTH on arrays; they are string-only and read false
Keep block-condition operators and form-validation operators apart; each surface offers a different menu
Lower-case the property side of IN and EQUAL conditions when data casing varies; matching is case-sensitive
Store a runCondition as a condition object; a bare string fails silently
Don't let a later action depend on a debounce or throttle node; those run unawaited and the next one can't see their work
Don't rely on executionType debounce or throttle inside onSuccessActions or onErrorActions; it is ignored there
Guard actions whose target id is a binding (blockId, drawerId, modalId) with a runCondition; empty on first run they reject
Put ackPreStart or ackPreEnd first in a walkthrough hook chain; the tour waits only one second
Copy JSON to the clipboard with {{ JSON.stringify(x) }}; a bound object copies as unquoted text or [object Object]
Write emitPageEvent eventType verbatim from the page's declared events, never as a binding or invented key
Signal executeScript failure through a page variable; a throw inside the script is caught and onErrorActions never fire
Reference entities in scripts by id, never by display name, and never put {{ }} inside a script string
Guard importObjects with a runCondition on objectId; an empty id stalls the whole chain silently
Write navigate preserveSearchParams as a real boolean; a binding or "false" counts as true
Use SET_IN and path for session storage, SET and key for local storage; the wrong vocabulary stores nothing
Give every setPageVariable an operation valid for the variable's type; absent or misspelled silently does nothing
Wrap a single item as {{ [item] }} for array APPEND or PREPEND; a bare item is rejected and the array unchanged
Guard shareEntityRecord with a runCondition on entityId; an unloaded id reports success with no dialog
Never return a Promise from a page function; it becomes undefined with no error, so do async work in a data source
Write each validation rule, pattern or message once in a manual validator function and have blocks read its result
Gate a button on a validator with NOT_EQUAL "true", not EQUAL "false"; before the first run the value is undefined
Trigger a manual validator after each field write and on onPageLoad; it never runs by itself
Guard every level of a nested binding read with ?.; a missing key voids the whole expression, its fallback included
Put meta tags and page-wide stylesheets in the custom code header, never the footer
Escape third-party {{ }} templates in custom code scripts; every {{ }} in script text is evaluated
Don't use page custom code to style or read blocks; it can't see app state and breaks when markup changes
Call action members (navigateToPage, showNotification) from event actions, never inside a read-only binding
Read Razorpay errors by description, reason and numeric code; read UAE Pass errors by message
Test deviceContext biometric.available, not the biometric object, which is truthy on every web page
Compare envVariables against strings ('5', 'true'); a number or boolean comparison is always false
Test navigation activeItem for null, not undefined, and check item type before reading url or pageId
Never name a local storage key setValue, clear or values; they are shadowed
Guard queryMeta.basePath and location.origin before joining them into a URL; absent values write undefined
Compare pageParams as text and pageInputs as their declared type; mismatched types never match
Compare theme colorScheme with lowercase dark and let light fall through
Read user phone at contactDetails.phoneNumber and tenant attributes under customProperties
Format dates with MM for month (not mm) and pass values with a time; a date-only value prints a day early west of UTC
Use relative-time-ago, not relative-time-to-now, where a date can be in the future
Never call utils.downloadFile from a displayed binding; it fires on every recompute
Read a block's own value in its handlers as b_<id>['value'], never self, this or bare value, which clear silently
Pass formatNumber an object with value and an explicit locale; a bare number renders NaN and grouping varies per visitor
Use only preset names in formatDateByFormatType and convert ISO or epoch text to a Date first; relative presets throw on the wrong text
Format durations with a precision no coarser than the shortest value; formatTime returns an empty string below it
Compare deviceContext location status in UPPER case (USER_DENIED) and networkType as Wifi; lowercase never matches
Use /* */, never //, for comments inside {{ }}; bindings are joined onto one line and // empties the value
Key app-wide custom CSS on data-* attributes, not block ids, which change when blocks are cloned or re-created
Test for an empty string with MIN_LENGTH "1" or MAX_LENGTH "0"; there is no IS_EMPTY and EXISTS is true for ""
Define a primary key for tables
Define a primary key for repeatables
Enable message send Action for Copilot inputs
Use 'sm' size for Copilot on mobile overrides
Reimplement Icon with Card, Pressable or IconButton
Ensure card components contain header and footer
Pressable must include interactions, otherwise use Stack

Use Dynamic Pagination Total for Repeatables
Pagination State Not Wired to Data Source
Use an Image block for external images or graphics
Enable pagination for repeatables
Enable pull-to-refresh when using pagination
Avoid Using Index as Primary Key When Sorting Is Enabled
Paginate a nested table once it passes 50 rows
Use a time x-axis only when the data holds epochs; otherwise Category
Don't set barWidth on a chart with a dynamic size
Use the x-axis value for the first dimension and groupBy for the second
Avoid using inline thoughts layout
Use dual axes when series differ a lot in magnitude
Tally block types first; flag a large page using only 2-3 types, usually `stack` and `typography`
Flag a complete screen at or under `composition.md`'s block-type-diversity floor
Flag 2+ `stat-card` blocks with no non-stat-card content block beneath them
Flag a `stat-card` or repeated row with no container ancestor
Right-align number and money columns, left-align text, centre nothing; headers align like their column
Fill or remove composite slots left as `__PLACEHOLDER__`
Build repeated rows from Stack + Typography, not a Card
Rebuild identical hand-built sibling subtrees as one Repeatable, using literal `content.data` and `content.primaryKey`
Flag any large, low-diversity page with no justification line in the report's notes
Flag a list whose spec names a per-record action but has no affordance wired to it
Flag a list the spec calls grouped or filtered that has no real filter or grouping control
Flag a page whose whole body is one row of same-size icon-heading-text `card` blocks
Make a Table's first column a name a person reads, not an id
Round numbers shown for a quick look ($3.8M), keeping the exact value in the record
Show bulk actions only after rows are selected; show an active filter as on, with a clear
Put form labels above fields in one column, never a placeholder as label; mark the smaller group
Put a form error next to its field, saying how to fix it and keeping the input
Check the hand-rolled shape table against every page's outline before judging any single block
Name the replacement block and confirm it is in this app's catalog; `stepper`, `timeline`, `tag`, `statcard` are web-only
Read the replacement block's sheet before proposing it, including tab items and pane binding
Cite parent `blockId`, child count, repeated componentType sequence and `displayName` numbering as evidence
Don't flag a fixed small layout that will never be state- or data-driven
Check the form actually does what it promises
Give every interactive-looking control a real handler, judged by integration stage
Merge two Typography blocks holding one sentence only when already editing that block
Replace a Card used as a plain box with a Stack
Never mark a document verified, a payment paid or a request sent from a timer or a click; wait for the server answer
Chain actions after a form only on Submit form; Validate form always resolves, so a chained action runs even with empty required fields

Use a validation rule, not required, to force a box ticked or a toggle on; required passes when it is off
Write form validationRules for the VALID state; a rule written for the invalid state passes every bad value
Pair date field minDate and maxDate with dateRangeLimit, or out-of-range values from defaults or bindings submit
Tell users the allowed range on number fields; an out-of-range value is cleared with no message
Don't rely on required for an OTP field; a single digit passes, so validate the full length
Don't give KeyValue fields a fallbackValue when hideNilValueFields is on; fallback fields are never hidden
Give a CONTENT Loader styles.width w-full and a real height; a w-fit skeleton renders nothing
Set a Table's isDataEmpty to a row-count test; unset shows the empty state forever, a missing-data test shows it before load
Don't treat TextArea maxCharacters as validation; values from defaultValue or setValue are not truncated
Test emptiness on the bound row path plus ['length'], never data['length'] on the envelope or data MISSING
Put a step that must not run on failure in the failing node's onSuccessActions; sibling actions run even after an error
Hang refetch success toasts and retries on the data source's own onSuccess and onFailure, not on a controlDataSource node
Don't hide a Drawer to clear its inputs; reset the fields, since reopening shows the old values
Check mediaUploads errors after an upload; maxFiles drops extra files silently and success fires on partial uploads
Show an infinite list's bottom loader on isFetchingNextPage; isLoading stays false for page 2
Don't use a page's loader key for its own slow data; only template component placements read it
Save unsaved input on the action that navigates away; there is no leave or unload event, except the Android back button a mobile page takes with the onPageBack trigger
Give bindings on required page inputs a fallback or an on-page message; required stops no navigation
Read upload failures from mediaUploads errors[blockId], never an entry's error or hasError
Treat a missing device permission as not asked yet, not denied, before showing a blocked message
Seed a ButtonGroup-driven view from a page input or variable; selectedOptionId is empty until the first click
Render a count that has not loaded as a loader or dash, never 0
Don't pick text-white from the colour picker for typography
Remove hardcoded 'text-white' color usage from block
Remove hardcoded hex color values in custom CSS
Set client-specific logos instead of default brand assets
Fix style values stored as character-indexed objects like `{"0":"b","1":"g"}`
Flag a task's `App look:` line whose look is not stored in the theme or app header
Flag text sizes or weights off the App look's `type`/`weights`, and shadows when `depth` is flat
Take colours from tokens, not inline hex; in custom CSS use `var(--ds-*)` when the app has a look
Replace one-sided coloured stripes wider than 1px and gradient text (`background-clip: text`)
Remove hover lift or pointer effects from blocks with no click wired
Pull values from `get_style_options`, `get_color_tokens` and `get_icon_options`, not memory
Remove `backgroundSize` / `backgroundRepeat` from a block with no `backgroundImage`
Flag a page using only body text where `composition.md` calls for a section heading
Flag typography, accent colour or repeated controls that differ from a sibling page's without reason
Flag a complete screen with no look in notes, or a named look the config doesn't show
Store the theme font as one bare family name and pick only weights it ships; native matches by exact name, else draws the system font
Set the symbol and the favicon as well as the logo
Fill all three app logo slots, favicon, small and large, with the client's assets
Keep the accent (primary) for the main action, the selection and links, about a tenth of coloured area; headings and borders stay neutral
Give different statuses different colours; two statuses in the same grey cannot be told apart at a glance
Choose the brand colour from the subject; not the stock theme purple or a reflex purple-to-blue gradient nobody asked for
Don't put the same soft grey shadow under every card; shadows grow with height, or there are none
Never use pure #000000 for text
No identical fade-and-slide entrance on every section
Colour status by urgency: red means act now, amber look soon, green or grey fine
Colour tags only for states a person acts on; show a plain category as a neutral tag
Set the app font through the theme font families, never font-family on blocks; that misses text inside composite blocks
Point the app at a theme id that exists on the tenant; a missing theme falls back to the default purple
Make every grey token lean the same way: all warm, all cool or plain
Show a value that is simply none or zero (nothing due) as a quiet state, not in the error colour
Use 3 to 6 text sizes, each at least 1.1x the one before, with the largest at least twice the smallest
Set body text to 13 or 14 px in a daily or expert tool; 16 only on a demo
Use two font weights (400 and 600), adding a third only for one display size
Keep the largest text size for the one bold thing or a page's one big number, not for every heading
Leave corners to the look's three radii, small for tags, medium for buttons, large for cards; set no radius by hand
Set a Card's default shadow to none when the look's depth is flat or borders
Use one icon set across the app, in one style, one stroke and a few set sizes
Animate nothing on page load in a daily or expert tool; a demo may have one entrance
Use colour ids, not hex, in component styles on a dark-mode theme, or add a dark rule for each; a hex stays the same in dark
Remove an old look block from the app header once the app has its own theme; it covers the theme
Make theme hover, pressed and disabled states change colour only, never size or layout
Keep one header, one way to show a state and one place for the main action across the app's pages
Set a mobile app's whole-screen background in Theme Colors Background, not on a full-page Stack
Use a token, never a hex, for any native colour that changes between light and dark mode
Store a conditional border colour as borderColor {all: condition}, never as a condition object at the key's root
Leave a BottomSheet cornerRadius unset unless the design needs its own; a stored value stops following --bottomsheet-radius
Use a Button color, size or variant the app theme declares; an undeclared name renders unpadded with unset colour tokens
Set CodeEditor appearance.theme to dark in a dark app; inherit renders the light editor
Wrap raw lengths in style keys as {custom:"22px"}; a bare "22px" or "320px" is read as a class name and does nothing
Set a custom font through customStyles.fontFamily or the theme, never a font name in appearance.fontFamily
Change the theme through the app theme (seeds, typography, component styles), never per-page edits or hex in block styles
Set an app-wide font through the --fontFamily-* variables, not font-family on blocks
Edit the theme entity, not theme.cssVars, on an app that has a defaultThemeId; inline cssVars are dormant there
Use a style key's listed class or a real CSS value; an invented class id is dropped by the browser silently
Store borders as borderWidth, borderStyle and borderColor; borderStroke is never stored, and colour alone draws nothing
